== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug (Errata)]] (<code>1261_79</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 78), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-78-Commando_Training_Klorslug.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-commandotraining&klorslug-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deploytment restrictions (and “power -1”) in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except Corellian Retort) are not stacked on Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Cannot be canceled. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_79</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 78, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-78-Commando_Training_Klorslug-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B26 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
